The front (−z) is the south front facing the flower beds.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front view along the garden axis: central domed pavilion with the two long glasshouse wings and steps, blue sky
  2. side three-quarter showing the long glazed wing and the central domes, white timber frame
  3. other side three-quarter: long curved glazed wing at left with the central dome and cupola at right

json.notes: A white painted-timber glasshouse: a tall glazed domed pavilion with a lantern sits at the centre, flanked by two long glazed wings with barrel-vaulted roofs that run along x. The front (-z) has a small pedimented entrance porch over the steps. The white frame and glazing are the key colour and material cues.

photos: photo 1: the front from the south, along the garden axis, showing the central domed pavilion with a glass dome and cupola, the two long glazed wings extending left and right, and the steps up to the entrance, under blue sky.
photo 2: a side three-quarter view of the long glazed wing curving up to a low barrel roof at left, with the central dome and lantern at right and small glazed end pavilions with cupolas.
photo 3: the other side three-quarter view, with the long curved glazed wing at left and the central dome, cupola and lower glazed drum at right, all white painted timber frame.
